acceptance: A TDD deliverable with an exitedPID copy gets a floor line that names acsassert.ExitedPID (red before the change)
A copy of an unimportable helper with no kit equivalent gets the 'write the statements in the test function, define no helper' line
The testdup baseline count does not rise
fix: 1) Add acsassert.ExitedPID(t) (one home) and point the four exitedPID copies at it where the package can import pkg/acsassert. 2) The floor line for a copy whose source is not importable names the pkg/acsassert helper when one exists; else it says to write the statements in the test function and define no helper function (a renamed helper is still a copy). 3) Pin both through the real TDD handoff floor entry point.
summary: Failure class tdd|gate-block (class-b12f9c6e38c2) recurred 5 times (cycles 2349, 2365, 2408, 2532, 2567). The TDD agent writes a small helper in go/acs/cycleN/predicates_test.go whose body equals a helper in another package's _test.go (moduleDir three times; exitedPID in 2567, which already has 4 baselined copies). The handoff floor refuses the copy and names the source helper, but a _test.go helper of another package cannot be imported; the agent renames the helper instead of inlining it, and the cycle FAILs after one correction. pkg/acsassert gained ModuleDir, which ended the moduleDir copies; it has no process-exit helper.
title: the TDD floor refuses a copy of an unimportable test helper, so the cycle fails after one correction (class recurrence 5)
